offering.title: DACS attestation-bundle verification (d402)
offering.description: DACS attestation-bundle verification behind a d402 payment gate: POST /verify, 402 until paid, verdict plus an HTTP receipt that names the on-chain payment. Pricing and the other three services: commerce/offers.json.

x-pathos.draft: unsigned DACS-1 §6.3.4 draft; not a member of the listing wire shape and stripped before signing. The x-pathos block itself is not §6.3.4 and listing-pub refuses a record that still carries it.
x-pathos.publish: at deploy: present the seller identity under the deployer wallet's agent DID (listing-wire presentIdentity), set seller.identity, validity.notBefore and logical_address (dacs1:{CF-4 seller DID}:pathos-verify-bundle:v1), sign with listing-wire signDacs1Listing (or the producer-listing helper), drop this x-pathos block, then anchor with `npm run listing-pub -- --listing-file <signed> --mnemonic-env <ENV> --publisher-origin <origin>`; this file is never indexed as is
